pr_title: [Feature] Support extract_hidden_states for hybrid models on Ascend NPU
source_quote:
it's better to combine the `test_extract_hidden_states` and `test_extract_hidden_states_qwen35.py` into one file with pytest.parameterize.
Done — combined both into test_extract_hidden_states.py with pytest.mark.parametrize (dense_eager, dense_aclgraph, hybrid_dummy_eager), removed the qwen35 file, and updated test_config.yaml.

rule.description: 当多个测试文件测试同一功能的不同配置时，应合并为一个文件并使用 `pytest.mark.parametrize` 进行参数化，避免测试文件冗余。
